_help: p3-skills modes. Copy to ~/.config/p3-skills/modes.json to customise. Keys in 'set' are p3-equip slots: profile (power-saver|balanced|performance), gamemode (on|off), dnd (on|off), awake (on|off), brightness (0-100), volume (0-100|mute), nightlight (auto|off|4500|3500|2700), bluetooth (on|off|MAC), wifi (on|off|name). 'cost' is the SP shown (negative = restores). 'open' is an optional command run after casting.

modes.name: Study
modes.desc: Quiet, awake and focused for notes and PDFs.

modes.name: Gaming
modes.desc: Everything into frames: full power, no interruptions.

modes.name: Movie Night
modes.desc: Bright, loud enough, true colours, screen stays on.

modes.name: Night Owl
modes.desc: Warm, dim and quiet for late hours.

modes.name: Conserve
modes.desc: Stretch the battery: low power, dim, Bluetooth off.

modes.name: Everyday
modes.desc: Back to normal: balanced, notifications on, night light on schedule.
